Th — Marine HQ threat letter, the hand's percentile of the 96 posted bounties: S top 5% · A top 15% · B top 35% · C top 60% · D top 85% · E below · — unrated (no bounty posted). Bounty = the live Mythic+ score × 100,000 (reversible). Bands are cut on the posted bounty alone, so a letter is a position in the fleet, never a verdict. HAKI — ◆ Conqueror's, an Emperor Index at or above 0.80 — 4 hands. ● Armament, a counted MYTHIC raid parse on the current front — 38 hands. ○ Observation, every logged run brought in inside par — 78 hands. Every mark is a measurement, not a rank. Both axes are measured; nothing here is inferred. 55 hands carry BOTH axes and stand eligible for a throne (96 carry a scored bounty, 59 a current-tier raid log). A hand missing either axis cannot be crowned — no partial thrones; ties on the Index fall to the raw Mythic+ bounty. The raid parse counted is a hand's Mythic figure wherever one exists — Heroic counts at ×0.8, and only for hands with no Mythic log at all. A STANDING WEEKLY SECTION · INTERNAL MEMORANDUM From the Desk of the Auditor Branch G-31, internal memorandum RECOUNT PENDING The eliminations column of this branch has never been separately witnessed. Every figure standing in it was copied across from a return headed otherwise. This office has requested a recount at every edition since the file was opened. Each request has been received, verified against the very file it disputes, and closed. I am obliged to record that the sum does not close in the direction the seal claims, and that it moves further from closing every week the crew remains at sea. Until the branch is permitted to open the envelope, this office declines to certify the figures it is asked to publish. Respectfully, the arithmetic. -- Rear Admiral Kessan, Records Division This column is authored voice, not a measurement — the World Government accepts no responsibility for the arithmetic of its own auditors. No figure printed here enters the ledger. Silvermoon City RAKDISC · ENYÒ · OHNOMYAIS Rakdisc (Nightborne disc priest) drags the crew through the Court of the Sun on a transmog run, holding a robe up to the light while Enyò and Ohnomyais fake enthusiasm for the fourth identical shade of crimson. Stormwind City TOMMYBRAVOO · JOVALA · KIRRÁ Tommybravoo strikes a hero pose on the Trade District bridge for the guild recruitment poster while Jovala tries to hold the camera steady and Kirrá "accidentally" ninjas the fountain coins behind them. Orgrimmar REXXHAVOCC · BOONDOCKA · ELLEBASI Rexxhavocc squares up in the Valley of Honor brawler's ring, Boondocka taking side-bets on the fight while Ellebasi quietly reads the training dummy's "damage meter" and declares themselves the real winner. The Dark Portal HELLFUL · IMPKILLER · MARTYLOL Impkiller boots a stray imp back through the swirling portal like a field goal, Hellful cheering the distance while Martylol films it for the memes channel instead of watching the actual demon horde forming behind them. Dalaran RHANSÌK · BUCHALTER · KELOVA Buchalter does frantic arcane math on a floating chalkboard trying to prove the guild bank is short, while Rhansìk and Kelova toss illegal fireballs off the underbelly of the city just to watch them fall. Icecrown Citadel SHADOXII · SHADOXI · AIIME The Shadox twins pose for a "menacing" photo on the frozen throne steps — one throwing up rock-horns, the other slipping on the ice — as Aiime solemnly plants a guild banner in a snowdrift that immediately falls over. Elwynn Forest HEALYEAH · ARFAS Healyeah (Dracthyr) belly-flops off the Crystal Lake bridge to fish while Arfas naps against a haystack, both level-1'ing it up on a nostalgia day instead of pushing keys. Mount Hyjal / World Tree HEALMATES · PHYRTHEPALI · TINYX At the World Tree's roots, Phyrthepali (top healer) tries to lead a solemn "healer appreciation" ritual while Healmates gets openly bullied about a mid-fight death and Tinyx spams heart emotes to keep the peace. Ironforge KEGSMASHROLL · FLOGERON · YUR Kegsmashroll wins a Stonehearth stein-slamming contest by a mile, Flogeron passed out under the table, Yur riding a runaway forge-cart of ale kegs across the Great Forge platform. Caverns of Time / Tanaris RAKELL · ONESSARAIN · TOMMYBRAVOX Rakell argues with a Bronze Dragonflight keeper about "just one" reset to un-pull the last wipe, while Onessarain and Tommybravox loot the same treasure chest across three different timelines at once. Un'Goro Crater AMREVENGE · FLOOFWALL Amrevenge (BM hunter, +20 key record-holder) tames a snorting devilsaur mid-charge while Floofwall the pandaren brewmaster calmly brews tea on its back, betting it'll be the guild's best new tank. Undermine BREWZLEEH · MAILLO Brewzleeh runs a rigged three-card-monte / coin-flip table under the Undermine neon, raking in the guild's gold as Maillo — already deep in gambling debt — shoves one more "guaranteed winner" bet across the crate. Placed by the crew, printed as received. The News Coo takes no responsibility. Ship's Notices The GO AGANE bell rings at pull o'clock -- every night, forever, whether you are ready or not. Copium rations are again exhausted; the galley will honor hopium at the bar until further notice. Sea-King sighted off the port bow. Officers advise: pull it anyway. Kindly stop rolling Need on the repair bill. It is not group loot. It has never been group loot. Reminder from the Captain: our warrants are a filing error and we have killed nobody. Reminder from the crew: we are absolutely killers and the paperwork agrees with us. The Marine auditor came aboard again asking to see our books. Cook handed him the stew ledger. He stamped it, thanked us, and left visibly unhappy. Wiping tonight does not let the raid down -- it raises the guild's profile. This is not encouragement. Please stop cheering when it happens. Do not write to the World Government to complain about the bounties. The Captain has tried. Every single letter has made us more famous. Posted by order of the officers. Compliance is aspirational.
